hero.title:
Your story changes
every second.
Your tattoo does too
hero.lede: We fuse the permanence of body art with the boundless freedom of the digital universe. One tattoo on your skin. Infinite stories to tell.

steps.title:
Your life in motion,
direct to your skin.

step1.title: Scan the art
step1.desc: Anyone can bring their smartphone close to your tattoo. Designed under strict artistic standards: clean line, full contrast, instant readability.

step2.title: Discover the magic
step2.desc: Instantly your skin transmits what you decided to show at that precise moment. A photo. A video. A story. A secret.

step3.title: Evolve whenever you want
step3.desc: Changed channels? Want to show the video of your latest trip? Update it in seconds from the panel. No pain. No laser. No regrets.

benefits.title:
One tattoo. Three freedoms
no one gave you before.

benefit1.title: Absolute freedom
benefit1.desc: Transform the meaning of your tattoo as many times as you like. Today your portfolio, tomorrow your new project, then a private memory. Your mind is the only limit.

benefit2.title: Permanent redirection
benefit2.desc: Forget broken links. If your Instagram changes, you move your videos or rebuild your site, your tattoo will keep working perfectly. For life.

benefit3.title: Impeccable aesthetics
benefit3.desc: Designed with professional tattoo artists for a minimal, technological and deeply attractive piece.

specs.title:
Validated by
professional tattoo artists.
specs.lede: We know your skin is sacred. That's why we leave nothing to chance — dimensions, module, contrast and zones verified with tattooers who work fine line every day.

dimension.label: Dimension
dimension.note: 4 × 4 cm · Standard validated · tests underway at 3 × 3 cm without losing readability

module.label: Module
module.note: ≥ 1.2 mm · Minimum cell size for saturated ink and sharp border

contrast.label: Contrast
contrast.note: Full black ink · No shading · No gradient · background free of previous tattoos

error.label: Error correction
error.note: Level H (30%) · Tolerates touch-ups, scarring and skin aging

guarantee.label: Guarantee
guarantee.note: URL under your control · While the QR is well tattooed, the redirect is always yours

problem.title:
The world is evolving.
Why should your skin
have to stay behind?
problem.lede: Until now, getting a tattoo meant making a static decision for life. A name. A phase. A social profile that defines you today and is only a memory tomorrow.

card1.title: Endless laser sessions
card1.desc: Months of pain, irritation and half-promises. Expensive, slow, and rarely complete.

card2.title: A bigger, darker cover-up
card2.desc: Cover with more ink. Accept a design you didn't choose just to hide the previous one.

card3.title: Living with regret
card3.desc: Looking at the mirror every morning and remembering someone — or something — you're no longer.

demo.title:
One tattoo.
A thousand destinations.
demo.lede1: Your tattoo doesn't change. What changes is where it points.
demo.lede2: When someone scans your QR with the camera, we send them to the URL you choose in that moment: your portfolio, a video, your Instagram, a private landing. And you change it as many times as you want from your panel — in seconds, without returning to the studio.
demo.eyebrow: Tap an option · watch the screen

basico.name: Basic
basico.desc: Link your QR to an image or external URL. Change the destination whenever you want.

standard.name: Standard
standard.desc: Host your videos directly on the platform. More quality, more control.

q1.q: What if the original URL stops existing?
q1.a: No problem. The tattooed QR always points to your permanent identifier on Dynamic Tattoos. If the external URL dies, enter the dashboard and redirect it. The tattoo keeps working.

q2.q: How long does a tattooed QR last on skin?
q2.a: With quality ink and a skilled artist, like any fine tattoo: decades. We use error correction (level H) to tolerate touch-ups, scarring and aging.

q3.a: Yes, anytime. Your QR will keep working in static redirect mode (the last saved URL). To keep changing the destination, simply reactivate.

q4.q: Does it work on the wrist?
q4.a: It works, but curvature can affect readability. We recommend flat areas: inner forearm, outer biceps, calf or chest.

q5.q: Do I need to be a professional tattoo artist?
q5.a: No, but we recommend one experienced in fine lines. We send a technical guide and a stencil to your studio.
